playbooks.name: Legal NDA & Vendor Contract Playbook
playbooks.description: Standard legal compliance checks for liability limits, payment terms, and sub-processor clauses.

rules.name: Payment Term Discrepancy
rules.action_required: Confirm extended payment terms with Finance team.
rules.original_template: Payment terms set to standard Net 30 days.
rules.proposed_template: Payment terms extended to Net 60 days per vendor request.

rules.name: Third-Party Sub-processor Addition
rules.action_required: Verify data processing addendum (DPA) and security audit.
rules.original_template: Data processing limited exclusively to primary contracting party.
rules.proposed_template: Data processing permission expanded to include third-party sub-processors.

rules.name: Limitation of Liability Cap
rules.action_required: Escalate liability cap change to Legal Counsel.
rules.original_template: Liability capped at 12 months total contract value.
rules.proposed_template: Liability cap modified to 1x annual contract value.

playbooks.name: Engineering & Security Compliance Playbook
playbooks.description: Checks project status reports for schedule delays, API deprecations, and audit findings.

rules.name: Milestone Schedule Slippage
rules.action_required: Review updated project roadmap with Engineering Lead.
rules.original_template: Milestone delivery scheduled for original target date.
rules.proposed_template: Milestone delivery delayed by 2 weeks due to compliance audit.

rules.name: API Integration Compliance
rules.action_required: Ensure backward compatibility and API rate limiting.
rules.original_template: API integration using legacy v1 endpoints.
rules.proposed_template: API integration upgraded to OAuth 2.0 and REST v2 endpoints.
